lines.en: label utamaid10:
scene utamaidten1
Once again, I find myself spending way too much time and way too much money at the maid cafe.
lines.zh: 又一次，我发觉自己在这家女仆咖啡厅里耗掉了太多时间，也花掉了太多钱。

lines.en: I’ve been here for going on two hours so far and, despite several other customers coming in, I’ve managed to keep Uta-chan all to myself.
lines.zh: 到目前为止我已经在这儿待了将近两个小时，尽管陆续又进来了几位客人，我还是成功地把 Uta 酱一个人霸占住了。

lines.en: This has, of course, come at a great cost.
lines.zh: 当然，这是付出了巨大代价换来的。

lines.en: And if Yumi winds up being cut off of my phone plan as a result, I have no regrets.
lines.zh: 如果 Yumi 因此被从我的手机套餐里踢出去，我也毫无遗憾。

lines.en: : Hey, Uta. How would you feel about Yumi working here so I don’t have to pay for her cell phone anymore?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Uta。让 Yumi 也来这儿打工，这样我就不用再替她交手机费了，你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: scene utamaidten2
: Yumi? Working here?
lines.zh: : Yumi？来这儿打工？

lines.en: : Not just anybody can be a maid, Master. This line of work takes a surprising amount of skill and perseverance.
lines.zh: : 可不是随便什么人都能当女仆的，Master。这一行需要的技巧和毅力，多得让人吃惊。

lines.en: : True. She might be a “business owner,” but I don’t think she’s quite conniving enough to hold down the fort here.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。她好歹也算个「个体户」，但我觉得她还不够奸诈，撑不起这儿的场面。

lines.en: scene utamaidten3
: Now you’re startin’ to get it.
lines.zh: : 您总算开窍了。

lines.en: : Also, aren’t you going to ask about why I’m paying for her phone bill?
lines.zh: : 还有，你就不问问，我为什么要替她交手机费吗？

lines.en: : Is it cause she’s poor and you want her to touch your wiener?
lines.zh: : 是不是因为她穷，而您想让她摸您的小鸡鸡？

lines.en: : That-
lines.zh: : 这个——

lines.en: : I mean, you’re not entirely wrong.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你说得也不算全错。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re allowed to say “wiener” while you’re working, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你上班的时候，我觉得应该不能说「小鸡鸡」吧。

lines.en: : Master is a special customer who won’t tell my boss even if I start doing really mean things like spitting in his food or stealing money directly out of his wallet.
lines.zh: : Master 是特别的客人，就算我开始干些特别过分的事，比如往他的菜里吐口水、或者直接把手伸进他钱包里偷钱，他也不会去跟老板告状。

lines.en: : To be fair, I think I’ve already proven that my wallet is as good as yours.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，我觉得我已经证明过了，我的钱包跟你的没什么两样。

lines.en: scene utamaidten4
: Poor Ami. She’s so dedicated to you and yet here you are, flirting with her senpai.
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Ami。她对您那么死心塌地，可您倒好，在这儿跟她的前辈调情。

lines.en: : Yes but, on the bright side, she at least has some spending money now.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过往好了想，她现在至少有点零花钱了。

lines.en: scene utamaidten5
: But not as much as {i}I{/i} do...
lines.zh: : 可是没有{i}我{/i}的多……

lines.en: : You know, Master...maybe if you bought Uta-chan a car...you would get to see her a little more often.
lines.zh: : 您知道的，Master……要是您给 Uta 酱买辆车……您就能多见她几面了。

lines.en: : I haven’t even bought a car for myself yet.
lines.zh: : 我连自己的车都还没买呢。

lines.en: : Wanna share one?
lines.zh: : 那要不要合用一辆？

lines.en: : You’ve gotta put it in your name, though, cause I don’t have any credit history yet.
lines.zh: : 不过得写在您的名下，因为我还没有任何信用记录。

lines.en: : Please don’t push me on this because I {i}will{/i} cave if you’re the one asking.
lines.zh: : 求你别在这事上逼我，因为只要开口的是你，我{i}一定{/i}会投降。

lines.en: : Pleeeeease, Master? Uta-chan’s been such a good girl.
lines.zh: : 拜——托嘛，Master？Uta 酱一直都很乖的。

lines.en: scene utamaidten6
: She even made all this delicious food for you all by herself.
lines.zh: : 她还亲手为您做了这么多好吃的呢。

lines.en: : I know for a fact that you have other maids cooking in the back room.
lines.zh: : 我可清楚得很，后厨还有别的女仆在做菜。

lines.en: : But if you use your imagination, it’s exactly like {i}I{/i} made it, right?
lines.zh: : 可只要您发挥一下想象力，就跟是{i}我{/i}做的一模一样了，对吧？

lines.en: : Wrong. And you’re not getting a car.
lines.zh: : 错。而且你别想拿到车。

lines.en: scene utamaidten7
: But...but I wanted to take you somewhere special to me...
lines.zh: : 可……可我本来想带您去一个对我来说很特别的地方……

lines.en: : I guess you hate me, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我看您是讨厌我吧……

lines.en: : What is this “special” place you were going to take me to, Uta-chan?
lines.zh: : Uta 酱，你原本要带我去的这个「特别」的地方，是哪儿？

lines.en: scene utamaidten8
: The mall.
lines.zh: : 商场。

lines.en: : That’s hardly special.
lines.zh: : 那可算不上什么特别。

lines.en: : Isn’t any place special as long as you leave happier than you were when you arrived?
lines.zh: : 只要您离开时比进来时更开心，那不管哪儿不都很特别吗？

lines.en: : Not if it comes at the cost of half of my salary and-
lines.zh: : 如果代价是我一半的薪水，那就不特别了，而且——

lines.en: : Oh. Wait. That's around the same amount I'm spending here.
lines.zh: : 哦。等等。这跟我在这儿花的差不多啊。

lines.en: scene utamaidten9
: Yup! And this place is the most special place on earth to you!
lines.zh: : 对呀！而且这儿对您来说是全世界最特别的地方！

lines.en: : You’ve really got to stop being so easy, though, Master. Uta-chan might be the perfect maid and she might like you very much, but you still work just as hard as-
lines.zh: : 不过您真的别这么好说话了，Master。Uta 酱也许是完美的女仆，也许也很喜欢您，可您还是跟——一样拼命干活。

lines.en: : I’m going to stop you right there because we are both well aware that I do not work hard at all.
lines.zh: : 我得在这儿打断你一下，因为我们俩都心知肚明，我根本一点都不拼命。

lines.en: scene utamaidten10
: Thanks, I don’t know if I was gonna be able to finish that sentence anyway.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，反正那句话我大概也说不完。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m pretty sure I worked harder on the whole dorm wars thing than you’ve worked since I transferred in.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我敢肯定，光是宿舍大战那件事，我花的力气就比我转学以来您干过的所有活儿都多。

lines.en: : That’s a very fair assessment. However, I implore you to remember who it was that {i}judged{/i} those competitions.
lines.zh: : 这评价非常中肯。不过，我恳请你回想一下，当初{i}当裁判{/i}评判那些比赛的人是谁。

lines.en: : Did having your childhood girlfriend ride your morning wood while Makoto and I spectated tire you out?
lines.zh: : 是让您青梅竹马的女友骑在您的晨间小帐篷上、而我和 Makoto 在旁边观战，把您给累着了吗？

lines.en: : Noriko’s {i}sister{/i} was my childhood girlfriend. Not Noriko.
lines.zh: : 我的青梅竹马是 Noriko 的{i}姐姐{/i}。不是 Noriko。

lines.en: : Also, how do you know that?
lines.zh: : 还有，你怎么会知道这个？

lines.en: scene utamaidten11
: I didn’t...
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊……

lines.en: : I was just makin’ a joke and now I know a thing that’s gonna really upset Maya when she finds out you’re cheating on her.
lines.zh: : 我不过是开个玩笑，结果现在我知道了一件事，等 Maya 发现您在劈腿，她肯定会气坏的。

lines.en: : For the millionth time, Maya and I are not dating.
lines.zh: : 我说第一百万遍了，我和 Maya 没有在交往。

lines.en: : Does Maya know that?
lines.zh: : Maya 知道这件事吗？

lines.en: : Maya will tell you the same exact thing.
lines.zh: : 你去问 Maya，她也会一字不差地这么跟你说。

lines.en: : Maya told me you two go at it all night long.
lines.zh: : Maya 跟我说，你们俩整晚都在干那事儿呢。

lines.en: : I know Maya well enough to confirm that this is not a thing she would ever say.
lines.zh: : 我对 Maya 还算了解，可以确认她绝不可能说出这种话。

lines.en: scene utamaidten12
: A-ha! So you {i}are{/i} dating!
lines.zh: : 啊哈！所以你们{i}真的{/i}在交往！

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : I bet you two bang like bunnies in her dorm room while Ami is here at the cafe!
lines.zh: : 我敢打赌，Ami 在咖啡厅上班的时候，你们俩就在她宿舍里像兔子一样乱搞！

lines.en: {i}God I wish.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}天哪，我也希望如此。{/i}

lines.en: : Ami works mornings. Even I’m not so much of a degenerate that I would wake up extra early just to go have sex with someone.
lines.zh: : Ami 上的是早班。就算我再堕落，也不至于为了跟谁上床而特地早起。

lines.en: scene utamaidten13
: Wh...What if that someone was...
lines.zh: : 那……如果那个人是……

lines.en: : I would go a year without sleeping if it meant even seeing you naked.
lines.zh: : 哪怕只是为了看你一眼裸体的样子，让我一年不睡觉我都愿意。

lines.en: scene utamaidten12
: A-ha! I knew it!
lines.zh: : 啊哈！我就知道！

lines.en: : And sorry, Master! But you’re still a bajillion years away from seeing Uta-chan’s little girls up close and personal!
lines.zh: : 不过抱歉啦，Master！您想近距离亲近 Uta 酱那两个小姑娘，还差着十万八千年呢！

lines.en: : Maya, though-
lines.zh: : 不过 Maya 的话——

lines.en: : I feel like that’s somehow even further off.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那反而更遥遥无期。

lines.en: scene utamaidten14
: I feel like you’re a bad judge of character.
lines.zh: : 我觉得您看人的眼光实在不行。

lines.en: : Didn’t you see how she freaked out when Noriko transferred in? Why would she have done that if she didn’t feel something for you?
lines.zh: : 您没看见 Noriko 转学来的时候她有多抓狂吗？如果她对您没有感觉，她干嘛要那样？

lines.en: : Because she feels many {i}negative{/i} things about Noriko.
lines.zh: : 因为她对 Noriko 怀着许多{i}负面{/i}的情绪。

lines.en: : And that’s not just you in denial?
lines.zh: : 那该不会只是您自己在否认吧？

lines.en: : You know what? Let’s just talk about something else.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我们还是换个话题吧。

lines.en: : Must be kinda exhausting having so many people you’ve gotta split your time between, huh?
lines.zh: : 要把时间分给这么多人，一定挺累人的吧？

lines.en: : It’s less exhausting if I can manage to keep all of that time a secret from literally everyone.
lines.zh: : 只要我能把所有这些时间对所有人都守口如瓶，就没那么累。

lines.en: : Aren’t ya telling the wrong person? I can’t be trusted with that kinda info.
lines.zh: : 您是不是找错人说啦？我这种人可守不住这种消息。

lines.en: : It’s fine because I’m telling Uta-chan and not Uta.
lines.zh: : 没关系，因为我说给的是 Uta 酱，不是 Uta。

lines.en: scene utamaidten15
: Ah! Loophole!
lines.zh: : 啊！漏洞！

lines.en: : Uta-chan doesn’t go to[school], so all of the secrets she knows disappear and reset each time she switches character modes!
lines.zh: : Uta 酱不上[school]，所以每次她切换人格模式，她知道的所有秘密就会消失、重置！

lines.en: : You’re a genius, Master!
lines.zh: : 您真是个天才，Master！

lines.en: : No, I’m just very good at concealing inevitable truths from myself and everyone around me.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是很擅长把那些不可避免的真相，瞒住我自己、也瞒住我身边的所有人。

lines.en: if dormwarfloor1win == True:
scene utamaidten16
: Speakin’ of inevitable truths...enjoy your stay with the stupid floor one girls during the beach trip and not with us cuter, spunkier gals from the second floor!
lines.zh: : 说到不可避免的真相……海滩之旅期间，您就好好陪一楼那帮蠢女生吧，别来找我们二楼这些更可爱、更有活力的姑娘！

lines.en: : Sounds to me like someone is still a little bitter about losing.
lines.zh: : 听起来有人对输了这件事还有点耿耿于怀啊。

lines.en: : As bitter as the black coffee that I also made for you all by myself.
lines.zh: : 就像我亲手给您煮的那杯黑咖啡一样苦。

lines.en: : It’s a little less impressive making coffee than it is making like four different entrees.
lines.zh: : 煮咖啡可比做出四道不同的主菜要逊色多了。

lines.en: : Thankfully, you didn’t make any of those, so it’s not something we should worry about right now.
lines.zh: : 谢天谢地，那几道菜您一道都没做，所以这事儿我们眼下不用担心。

lines.en: scene utamaidten14
: Did you at least have fun?
lines.zh: : 您至少玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Makoto and I busted our butts and, even if my floor doesn’t get to keep you overnight, I still feel like we all got a little closer to you and everybody else.
lines.zh: : 我和 Makoto 可是拼了老命，就算我们这层楼没能留您过夜，我还是觉得大家都跟您、跟彼此更亲近了一点。

lines.en: if dormwarfloor2win == True:
scene utamaidten12
: Speakin’ of inevitable truths, how ‘bout those second floor gals, right?!
lines.zh: : 说到不可避免的真相，二楼那帮姑娘怎么样，哈？！

lines.en: : Is it time to brag about your recent victory?
lines.zh: : 现在是该吹嘘你们最近的胜利了吗？

lines.en: : It’s time to brag about Uta Ushibori’s recent victory! Uta-chan has no affiliation with that tiny bundle of boobies!
lines.zh: : 是该吹嘘 Uta Ushibori 最近的胜利了！Uta 酱跟那个小小的、全是胸的小家伙可没有任何关系！

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad that you won. It was a well fought battle and I’m excited to-
lines.zh: : 嗯，你们赢了我很高兴。那是一场打得漂亮的仗，我也很期待——

lines.en: : Get busy with a bunch of thirsty girls in the middle of the night?!
lines.zh: : 期待半夜跟一群饥渴的姑娘们忙活起来？！

lines.en: : Shh. Maya could be around the corner and we don’t want her to get jealous.
lines.zh: : 嘘。Maya 说不定就在拐角处，我们可不想让她吃醋。

lines.en: scene utamaidten15
: Ah! Good point! If you’re cheatin’ on her, we’ve gotta keep it a secret!
lines.zh: : 啊！有道理！要是您在劈腿，那我们得保密！

lines.en: : Thank you for understanding, Uta-chan.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的体谅，Uta 酱。

lines.en: : Yeah! If Maya finds out and kills you, who else will buy every item on the menu three times a week?
lines.zh: : 对呀！要是 Maya 发现然后把您杀了，还有谁会一周三次把菜单上每样东西都点一遍？

lines.en: : I’ve gotta make money somehow, Master!
lines.zh: : 我总得想办法赚钱啊，Master！

lines.en: : Oh.
scene utamaidten14
: Did you have fun, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，您玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : During the dorm war, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说，在宿舍大战期间。

lines.en: : Makoto and I busted our butts on that thing.
lines.zh: : 我和 Makoto 在那件事上可是拼了老命。

lines.en: if dormwartie == True:
scene utamaidten16
: Speakin’ of inevitable truths, how the heck did the dorm war end in a tie?!
lines.zh: : 说到不可避免的真相，宿舍大战到底是怎么打成平手的？！

lines.en: : Uta, do you understand what the word “inevitable” means? Because that outcome was definitely not something predetermined and it’s my fault things ended up that way.
lines.zh: : Uta，你知道「不可避免」这个词是什么意思吗？那个结果绝对不是什么注定的事，而且事情变成那样是我的错。

lines.en: : Then why’d ya let that happen?! That was a great chance to prove to us second floor girls that we’re not too far behind the rest of the crowd!
lines.zh: : 那您为什么还让它发生了？！那可是个绝佳的机会，好让我们二楼的姑娘证明自己并没有落后别人太多！

lines.en: : I just judged the competition based on who I thought should win. It wasn’t about who is further ahead or further behind in terms of relationships with me.
lines.zh: : 我只是按照我觉得谁该赢来评判比赛。这跟谁在跟我关系上领先或落后无关。

lines.en: scene utamaidten14
: I know, I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道……

lines.en: : Just kinda anticlimactic to spend the whole weekend fighting and then not even have a winner.
lines.zh: : 只是花了一整个周末拼死拼活，最后连个赢家都没有，有点虎头蛇尾。

lines.en: : Did you at least have fun, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，您至少玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I had a lot of fun. And I’m sure the beach will be just as good.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我玩得很开心。而且我敢肯定海滩之行也一样棒。

lines.en: scene utamaidten17
: Yeah...what’s up with that, by the way?
lines.zh: : 是吗……话说回来，这到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean like, why organize a trip to the beach in winter? Isn’t that a little weird?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，为什么要在冬天组织一次海滩之旅？不觉得有点奇怪吗？

lines.en: It’s not like that was the {i}original{/i} plan.
lines.zh: 那本来也{i}不是{/i}最初的计划。

lines.en: We just...apparently do that every other cycle or something?
lines.zh: 我们只是……好像每隔一个循环就会来这么一次什么的？

lines.en: I still have no idea how or why it works, but I’m not about to question the mysteries of the universe if they're going to create more opportunities for me to see girls with less clothing on.
lines.zh: 我到现在也没弄明白这到底是怎么回事、为什么行得通，不过既然宇宙的这些谜团能给我创造更多机会，看到穿得更少的女孩，我也就不打算去追问了。

lines.en: : Beats me. But a vacation is a vacation.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。不过度假就是度假嘛。

lines.en: scene utamaidten18
: Ahh, yes. Yes. Of course you wouldn’t question the reasoning behind it because you know you’ll get to stare at my butt for {i}real{/i} this time.
lines.zh: : 啊，是。是。您当然不会去追问理由，因为您知道自己这回能{i}真的{/i}盯着我的屁股看了。

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 一点没错。

lines.en: : Do what you must. But please do not touch the merchandise without first putting a down payment on it.
lines.zh: : 您想看就看吧。不过请先付定金，不然请勿触摸商品。

lines.en: : Is everything I spend here not enough of a down payment?
lines.zh: : 我在这儿花的所有钱，还不够当定金吗？

lines.en: : Cheating is bad, Master. I can not support your efforts to mislead Princess Maya no matter how much you like my butt.
lines.zh: : 劈腿是不对的，Master。不管您多喜欢我的屁股，我都不能帮着您去误导 Maya 公主。

lines.en: : On a more serious note, though, I am kinda worried about this whole beach thing.
lines.zh: : 不过说点正经的，我对这趟海滩之行是有点担心。

lines.en: : We had a couple ponds and stuff in Nara, but I’ve never been in the ocean before.
lines.zh: : 奈良那边是有几个池塘什么的，但我从来没下过海。

lines.en: scene utamaidten19
: You gonna protect me from sharks and stuff? And make sure I don’t drown?
lines.zh: : 您会保护我不被鲨鱼什么的吃掉吗？还会保证我不会淹死吧？

lines.en: : I was kind of planning on just watching from the sidelines and then probably going back to my room to relax.
lines.zh: : 我本来就打算在场边看看，然后大概就回房间休息了。

lines.en: And by relax I mean have sex with an assorted variety of girls because it is much harder to contain myself in situations where I am permanently erect.
lines.zh: 至于「休息」嘛，我指的是跟各式各样的女孩上床，因为在我一直硬着的情况下，要忍住实在太难了。

lines.en: scene utamaidten20
: Ugh! You and Io are exactly the same! Always bein’ so...antisocial and stuff.
lines.zh: : 啧！您和 Io 真是一模一样！老是那么……不合群什么的。

lines.en: : Like, what’s so hard about goin’ out there and havin’ fun?! Jeez!
lines.zh: : 出去玩玩、开开心心的到底有多难啊？！天哪！

lines.en: : Having fun is exhausting. I’d much prefer to keep myself separated from that side of existing and simply reap the benefits that come from {i}other{/i} people having fun.
lines.zh: : 玩乐是很累人的。我倒宁愿把自己和存在的那一面隔开，只管坐收{i}别人{/i}玩乐带来的好处。

lines.en: scene utamaidten21
: Guh. No wonder she snuck into your room instead of joining in on our slumber party.
lines.zh: : 呃。怪不得她宁可溜进您房间，也不来参加我们的睡衣派对。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I’m just going to assume she told you and that you’re not secretly surveilling my every move.
lines.zh: : 我就当是她告诉你的吧，而不是你在偷偷监视我的每一个举动。

lines.en: scene utamaidten22
: Yeah, but don’t get mad at her about it. I kinda forced it out of her.
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过别为这个生她的气。是我硬逼她说出来的。

lines.en: : Io can be really complicated, but I know how to deal with her for the most part.
lines.zh: : Io 有时候真的很复杂，不过大体上我知道该怎么跟她相处。

lines.en: : Takes one to know one and all that.
lines.zh: : 正所谓同病相怜嘛。

lines.en: : I definitely don’t see any sort of resemblance between the two of you, so I’m not sure how accurate that last statement is.
lines.zh: : 我可完全看不出你们俩有什么相似之处，所以最后那句话准不准，我就不清楚了。

lines.en: scene utamaidten23
: Okay. Maybe I’m a little {i}less{/i} complicated than her...but that doesn’t mean what you see is what you get.
lines.zh: : 好吧。也许我是比她{i}稍微{/i}简单一点……但这也不代表你看到的就是我的全部。

lines.en: : We’re all a little complicated in our own ways, Master.
lines.zh: : 我们每个人都有自己的复杂之处，Master。

lines.en: : Io...me...you...
: But that’s what makes us people. Nobody can be happy all the time and we’ve all gotta do everything we can to keep a smile on our faces, even when it seems impossible to do that.
lines.zh: : 可这正是我们之所以为人的地方。没有人能永远快乐，我们都得拼尽全力保持笑脸，哪怕看起来根本做不到。

lines.en: : Am I going to be charged extra for this life lesson? Because I’m kind of running out of money.
lines.zh: : 这堂人生课要另外收费吗？因为我的钱快花光了。

lines.en: scene utamaidten24
: Course not.
lines.zh: : 当然不收。

lines.en: : I’m just sayin’ that you can never really know what somebody is like unless you spend lots and lots of time with them.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，除非你跟一个人相处很久很久，否则你永远不可能真正了解他是什么样的人。

lines.en: : That’s why I feel comfortable saying I’m not much different than Io.
lines.zh: : 所以我很笃定地说，我和 Io 没什么两样。

lines.en: : We’ve just got...unique ways of handlin’ the stuff that hurts us the most.
lines.zh: : 我们只是……处理那些伤我们最深的事时，各有各的独特方式。

lines.en: : I’m sure you do too.
lines.zh: : 我相信您也有。

lines.en: : But it’s not up to me to point out your bad sides. ‘Specially not while I’m wearin’ a maid outfit.
lines.zh: : 不过轮不到我来指出您不好的那一面。尤其在我穿着女仆装的时候。

lines.en: : Excuse me, Uta-chan, but you shouldn’t be pointing out or acknowledging that I even {i}have{/i} bad sides while you’re wearing that outfit.
lines.zh: : 不好意思，Uta 酱，可你穿着那身衣服的时候，连我{i}有{/i}不好的一面这种事都不该指出来、不该承认。

lines.en: scene utamaidten25
: R-Right...I’m sorry, Master.
lines.zh: : 是……是……对不起，Master。

lines.en: scene utamaidten26
: So, back to happier things!
lines.zh: : 那么，还是聊点更快乐的事吧！

lines.en: : How ‘bout you tell me what exactly went down with you and Io at your hotel room?
lines.zh: : 您跟我说说，您和 Io 在您酒店房间里到底发生了什么呗？

lines.en: : She kinda skimped me on the deets.
lines.zh: : 她有点把细节省着没跟我说。

lines.en: : I wish the answer was exciting or interesting, but it’s actually kind of depressing.
lines.zh: : 我也希望答案能刺激点、有趣点，可惜实际上有点让人沮丧。

lines.en: : I’m all ears, Master! Let Uta-chan wash those worries away!
lines.zh: : 我洗耳恭听，Master！让 Uta 酱把那些烦恼都冲走吧！

lines.en: scene black
I tell Uta about the morning after Io snuck into my room, but conveniently leave out all of the details about how said morning ended up.
lines.zh: 我跟 Uta 讲了 Io 溜进我房间之后那个早上发生的事，但很巧地略去了那个早上最后是怎么收场的所有细节。

lines.en: It’s one thing having Io know about Chika, but trusting someone like Uta with that information seems like it could lead to catastrophe rather quickly.
lines.zh: 让 Io 知道 Chika 的事是一回事，可把这件事托付给 Uta 这样的人，似乎转眼间就会酿成大祸。

lines.en: It’s strange having one girl who loves secrets but can’t keep them paired with a second girl who hates secrets and {i}does{/i} keep them.
lines.zh: 一个女孩爱打听秘密却守不住，另一个女孩讨厌秘密却{i}守得住{/i}——两个凑在一起，感觉挺奇妙的。

lines.en: But I guess there’s not much helping it.
lines.zh: 不过我想这也由不得我。

lines.en: Maybe the two of them do have more in common than I realize.
lines.zh: 也许她们俩的共同点，真的比我想到的要多。

lines.en: But, at least on a surface level-
lines.zh: 不过，至少从表面上看——

lines.en: I can’t see it at all.
lines.zh: 我是一点也看不出来。

lines.en: I stay for another hour or so before Uta needs to stop talking to me and focus on closing the store.
lines.zh: 我又待了一个小时左右，直到 Uta 得停下跟我的闲聊，专心去打烊。

lines.en: And, as always, I head home with my hands in my pockets- one of them wrapped tightly around a wallet that is much lighter than normal.
lines.zh: 然后，和往常一样，我把双手揣进口袋里踏上归途——其中一只手紧紧攥着的钱包，比平时轻了不少。

lines.en: This girl is going to bleed me dry.
lines.zh: 这丫头迟早要把我榨干。
